content.short: Synthetify is a Solana-based platform that issues synthetic assets on-chain.
content.description: Founded in 2020 by Norbert Bodziony, Synthetify is a straightforward, user-friendly protocol for managing synthetic assets on the Solana blockchain. Solana-native users can mint SPL tokens pegged to the prices of traditional assets, enabling real-world assets to be represented on-chain and readily used with a variety of DeFi protocols in the Solana ecosystem. The project is fully decentralized, non-custodial, and accessible from any device.
